name: Setup: recipe and prerequisites
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE sharp high-fidelity desktop Acclimate web-app layout, landscape1440x900. Input image is reference for real product content and its current shadcn Mira look, not a layout to copy. Restrained light off-white, white content, graphite text, muted olive accents, readable14px minimum body/control/source text,32-36px desktop controls, quiet borders. Keep current labeled176px app sidebar (workspace switcher, Bundles, Connections, Members, Account) and compact single scope header: Back, BDD bundle, Channel stable, Content/Changes/Releases/App setup, Refresh. Don't redesign this already-good shell. No browser frame, decoration, analytics, fake counts, invented features, fake connected/success states or tiny text. No repeated context or full-width cards around every sentence. Screen: App setup for BDD bundle/stable, language TypeScript selected with Python alternative. Apps own agent tools/model credentials. Install: Node.js22.22+ and @acclimate/sdk tarball from admin or source checkout; DO NOT invent a publicly published npm install @acclimate/sdk. Valid generic command 'npm install /path/to/sdk.tgz' clearly a replaceable file path. Existing Install from this checkout disclosure has npm run build:packages then npm pack --workspace @acclimate/sdk. Required PRIVATE app settings are ACCLIMATE_URL, ACCLIMATE_TOKEN, ACCLIMATE_SCOPE, ACCLIMATE_CACHE, ACCLIMATE_JOB_DIR. Token is supplied by workspace admin/Connections, never show a real secret or imply already configured. Scope/cache/job directories must be private and identity-separated. Concrete model-free delivery check: copy TypeScript recipe, save delivery-check.mts, run npx tsx delivery-check.mts; prints pinned version, digest and observed app start then cleans files. NO Run agent button, no fake printed result, no fabricated credential. Existing TypeScript recipe is readonly source beginning 'import { spawn } from node:child_process' and 'import { AcclimateClient, resolveAndCache, prepareFiles } from @acclimate/sdk'; depict realistic code but no invented APIs. Optional delivery reports, Workspace and bundle IDs, Cache/offline details remain secondary. Architecture: one compact setup header with language segmented controls. Main two-column layout: wide readable readonly TypeScript recipe and Copy recipe on left; a280px reference column on right with real Install prerequisites, required private setting names and Manage app credentials link. Code is visible immediately, but above it a clear factual prerequisite sentence says install SDK and configure private environment first; do not imply ready/connected. The run command and factual expected output directly below code header. Optional reports/cache/IDs grouped below both columns. Avoid cramped sidebars and giant instructional cards; existing app sidebar remains distinct.
